hero.title: Make your stream
hero.copy: The Road to Somewhere builds tools and visual experiences for streamers who want to provide visual responses to events that happen on their streams, and content to engage their viewers.

extensions.title: Streamer.bot Extensions
extensions.text: Built to be installed easily, configured clearly, and seen on stream.

other.title: Tools for your streaming setup.
other.text: Useful tools for OBS and the wider streaming workflow.

about.title: Tools and Widgets with a purpose.
paragraphs: The Road to Somewhere is a collection of tools designed to help you **REACT** to **EVENTS** and **INTERACTIONS** from your **AUDIENCE** and streaming **PLATFORMS** to help make your stream more **ENGAGING**.
Each project is designed as a complete experience: polished visuals, useful configuration, clear documentation, and sensible installation.

support.title: Every project comes with documentation that tells you what to do — and why.
support.text: Installation steps, settings references, troubleshooting, and release notes will live alongside each product.
